text:
leo_fin: Weird anomaly from Sept billing export: a vendor pricing experiment (CloudTier promo) reduced unit price for some GPU instances, but our ingest cost-normalizer didn't catch the override. ~$9,120 of GPU spend was attributed at the higher pre-promo rate to `unallocated` instead of adjusting to the promo-adjusted cost centers. Need provisional reallocation and an audit trail.

ana_ops: Can you share the invoice-lines or sample? I want to confirm which ingest window missed the promo flag.

leo_fin: Uploaded details: gs://billing-backfills/2024-09-cloudtier-mismatch.csv. Sample rows below. Looks like the promo tag `vendor_promo=CT-SEPT` arrived in vendor metadata after our ingest job for the 2024-09-15 window.

Sample:
```
invoice_id,line_id,amount,orig_center,vendor_meta,desired_alloc
CT-20240915,11,1020.00,unallocated,"promo=none;tier=standard","platform:0.6;search:0.4"
CT-20240915,12,880.00,unallocated,"promo=CT-SEPT;tier=discount","platform:0.6;search:0.4"
```

ana_ops: Root cause: our ingest runs at 02:00Z but vendor's promo feed updated at 02:45Z for that day. Ingest didn't get the later feed so some lines missed the promo flag. Ops can either (A) re-ingest the affected invoice range after merging vendor metadata, or (B) apply a corrective transform that adjusts cost basis to the promo rate. Preference?

kai_platform: Platform prefers applying corrective transform so ledger shows the intended cost allocation now, then we can reconcile with vendor credit when they confirm. Any customer-facing credits?

leo_fin: Quick check: three external customers have pass-through billing that references these GPU lines. Estimated external credit if we change invoice = $280. Finance policy: need VP Finance sign-off before issuing credits. Otherwise we can absorb internally and adjust cost centers.

tara_search: Product ok with Platform absorbing adjustments for internal allocation, but if external customers are affected we need explicit approval. Also ask procurement to confirm whether CloudTier will issue retroactive credit so we can reverse internal entries when credit arrives.

procurement-bot: Procurement notified CloudTier support (ticket CT-711). Requesting promo application logs and confirmation of retroactive credit. Procurement POC: procurement@redwood.ai.

ana_ops: Proposed ops command to apply corrective transform (non-invasive):
```
python infra/tools/adjust_pricing.py --input gs://billing-backfills/2024-09-cloudtier-mismatch.csv \
  --rule "if vendor_meta contains CT-SEPT then set unit_price=promo_price" \
  --out gs://billing-backfills/results/2024-09-cloudtier-adjust-2201234567.csv \
  --note "applied promo pricing transform pending vendor confirmation"
```

billing-bot: Billing pipeline: adjustment job queued (#11207) by ana_ops. ETA 22m. Outputs to gs://billing-backfills/results/2024-09-cloudtier-adjust-2201234567.csv

kai_platform: Platform lead DM'd approval to apply corrective transform and provisional split 60/40 (Platform/Search). I'll post confirmation here. Also request tagging entries with `promo_adjustment_provisional`.

leo_fin: Finance position: approve provisional internal absorption of $9,120 minus potential external credit exposure ($280). We'll hold external credit until VP Finance approves issuing customer credits. For now, mark external-customer lines for review and flag in ledger as `review_external`.

procurement-bot: CloudTier responded to CT-711: they confirmed promo retroactive application for the period and will issue a credit for the affected invoice lines within 7 business days. They asked for our list of affected invoice line_ids. Procurement uploaded the list to the ticket.

billing-bot: Job #11207 completed. Summary: 14 lines adjusted, total internal reallocated = $9,120.00, external-customer lines flagged = $280.00. Output: gs://billing-backfills/results/2024-09-cloudtier-adjust-2201234567.csv

leo_fin: Opening ledger PR with before/after rows and an audit note: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ledger/pull/478. Includes tags: PROMO_ADJUSTMENT_PROVISIONAL, REVIEW_EXTERNAL; cost centers PLATFORM-CORE and SEARCH-TEAM.

tara_search: Reviewed PR comments. Product approves provisional allocation and review flags.

kai_platform: Approved. Also opened a small ingest guard change: `ingest/vendor_meta_merge.py` to ensure vendor promo feeds are merged before finalizing invoice lines for that day. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/956.

procurement-bot: Procurement update: CloudTier ticket CT-711 marked "credit issued" and posted a credit memo reference CM-20240922. Procurement attached vendor credit memo.

leo_fin: Once credit posts we'll reverse the provisional internal allocation and apply the vendor credit to month-end. Finance will wait for procurement confirmation and then post reversal PR.

billing-bot: Ledger PR merged (#478). Accounting entries posted as provisional. Thread will remain open until procurement confirms credit applied. :white_check_mark:
